draft.subject: Your SSO question — and a first project in Wrenfield
draft.body:
Hi Mia,

Thanks for asking about SSO setup — your ticket is open and Tariq is on it. For context, SSO is available on the Team plan, and he'll follow up with the details.

In the meantime, the piece that usually makes everything else click is getting a first project going: projects are the main organizing unit, and tasks live inside them. The in-app onboarding flow walks through creating a first project.

Want me to walk you through setting up that first project on a quick call this week? Happy to work around your schedule.

Best,
Chidi
